name: Statsnet MCP
tagline: World company background checks over MCP.
shortDescription: Background check any company in the world: registration, executives, courts and finances.
longDescription:
## What it is

Statsnet remote MCP for worldwide company background checks: registration details, executives, government contracts, courts, and finances.

## Why we recommend it

Free public remote endpoint with Official Registry id `io.github.usenetstate/statsnet`. Useful for due diligence, sales research, and OSINT workflows in any MCP client.

## When to use it

- Company registration and officer lookup
- Court and financial signals
- Worldwide (not country-limited) background checks
installInstructions:
1. Open your MCP client settings
2. Add remote server URL: https://statsnet.co/mcp
3. Optional registry id: io.github.usenetstate/statsnet

No API key required for public MCP initialize.
pricingDetails: Public remote MCP endpoint; product features may have free and paid tiers on statsnet.co.
